responsibility: This generated option-table file contains the enumerated -march=, -mtune=, and -mips values accepted by the MIPS port. Produced from mips-cpus.def by genopt.sh, it records canonical CPU names and aliases, numeric ISA spellings, and special values such as from-abi and native in GCC’s .opt format, so the driver and option parser can map user command-line strings onto the backend’s processor and ISA enums.
